theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : StrictMono f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s < f (insert a s) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intros s a hna
    have := h (s ∪ {a}) (by simp [hna])
    rw [insert_eq_union, insert_union] at this
    exact this
  · intros x y hxy
    have := h' x (by simp [hxy])
    rw [insert_eq_union, insert_union] at this
    exact this
